## About
29th Street Auto is an honest and friendly family operated small business. We know car repair isn't fun or convenient for most people, so we try to make it as easy as we can.
Our ASE Master certified techs handle everything from a simple oil change to brakes, diagnostics, tires and engine work. We use current diagnostic technology and we'll tell you what we find.
A lot of our first-time customers end up coming back for good, and some send their friends and family our way. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.

## Services
- Brake Repair Specialists: Brake inspection and repair so you can stop with confidence.
- Complete Safety Analysis: A full look over your vehicle so you know where it stands.
- Steering & Suspension: Steering and suspension work for a car that handles and rides right.
- Air Conditioning Repair & Maintenance: Keeping your air conditioning working through the Phoenix heat.
- Radiators & Coolant Systems: Radiator and cooling system service to keep your engine from running hot.
- Fuel System Services: Service for the parts that get fuel to your engine.
- Alternators & Starters: When the car won't start or the battery keeps dying, we'll check the starter and alternator.
- Factory Scheduled Maintenance: The maintenance your manufacturer calls for, done on schedule.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imports as well as domestic cars?
A: Yes. Import or domestic, bring it in for maintenance or repairs.

Q: Can you do scheduled maintenance and extended warranty work?
A: Yes. We handle scheduled maintenance, extended warranty work and bigger technical repairs, along with everyday jobs like oil changes.

Q: What if I don't see my repair on your list?
A: Our list is just the common jobs. Give us a call and ask.
